primary_web_sources.finding: One GT2 open belt, nominal purchase length 1000 mm and width 6 mm; two 208 mm closed belts; three 20-tooth GT2 pulleys.
Interactive guide is a Thor v2 test-version guide; general videos may show older versions. Native assembly files are the version-matched geometry source.

native_probe.method: Read AssemblyArt2.FCStd/PartShape74.brp (Fusion154001) into Part.Shape without document recompute. Separately restore/recompute compatible AssemblyArt1 only with pinned legacy Gears and Fasteners. No source save, no whole-assembly run.

routing.cached_geometry: Open-ended belt; wraps below the motor, bends near two upper-arm tensioners, runs along outside of drum, ends near the drum top. No strand crossing in cached BREP.
routing.sign_status: CAD-supported candidate; not calibrated physical sign
routing.mismatch: Cached deflection arc centers about +/-17.73797 mm differ from installed idler-axis x about +/-14.5 mm in AssemblyArt2; cached arc radii differ from native 6 mm idler body. Do not derive exact contact angles or tension from this simplified envelope.

definitions.q2: Shoulder angle relative to Art1; same positive physical axis as q3
definitions.q3: Elbow/drum angle relative to upper-arm carrier
definitions.phi: Elbow gearbox output-pulley angle relative to Art1
definitions.R_p: Actual belt effective pitch-line radius at drum; unknown

conditional_kinematics.ideal_no_slip_constant_radius: phi = q2 + s * (R_p / r_m) * q3 + constant
conditional_kinematics.scope: Constant installed routing and radius, no slip/stretch/backlash; angular increments only. Not verified drive firmware or motion authorization.

unknowns: Actual belt part number, total/tooth/cord thickness and pitch-line location on smooth drum
Belt clamp/termination detail and physical route sign
Pretension, wrap contact, tooth engagement, elastic stiffness and slip limit
Measured motor output/shoulder/elbow relation across travel

conditional_envelope_bound.assumption: Only if actual pitch line stays within the modeled 37 to 38.5 mm annulus; not an asserted physical tolerance
conditional_envelope_bound.use: Sensitivity screening only; do not turn into verified ratio or capacity

thor_ros.finding: write() forms art2 from command index 1 and art3 from index 2 independently; B=C=art2 and D=art3 for thor_pcb. No shoulder-to-elbow term occurs in this write mapping.

asgard.finding: FKMoveArt2 sends B/C only; FKMoveArt3 sends D only. This is not evidence that firmware compensates mechanically coupled relative joints.

control_source_crosscheck.limitation: No running firmware inspected. Coordinate semantics/calibration may differ; do not equate these source G-code degree values to mechanical phi or q3.
